title: Connected fibres from formal functions and idempotents
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be proper, and assume $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)=R$. Then every scheme-theoretic fibre $X_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme].

source.place: More on Morphisms, proof of Theorem 37.53.5 (Tag 03H2), lines 15334--15357; the formal-functions input is Cohomology Lemma 30.4.1 (Tag 02OD), and the proper-fibre idempotent input is Derived Categories Lemma 21.16.1 (Tag 0G7X)

mathlib_searches.query: proper morphism with global sections equal to the base has nonempty connected fibres via formal functions and idempotents
mathlib_searches.results: no theorem; IsConnected and Scheme.Hom.fiber only

mathlib_searches.query: formal functions theorem proves connected fibres from absence of idempotents
mathlib_searches.results: no bundled result; nearby ConnectedSpace and idempotent lemmas are separate
no formal-functions theorem or proper-fibre idempotent criterion in Mathlib; only generic fibre and connectedness infrastructure
